title: Affine coordinate rings preserve local fibre dimension
statement: Let X and T be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], f : X → T a morphism and y a point of X. Put A = Γ(T, O_T), B = Γ(X, O_X), with the A-algebra structure on B induced by f. Let q be the prime of B corresponding to y under the canonical affine isomorphism and p its contraction to A. The local topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] of the scheme fibre of f at its distinguished point over y [def-pc-scheme-fibre] equals the local topological Krull dimension of Spec(κ(p) tensor_A B) at the prime corresponding to q under PrimeSpectrum.preimageHomeomorphFiber. There is no finite-type or finite-dimension hypothesis.

source.place: Remark 00E6 (fundamental diagram and topology of fibre spectra), together with Tag 01I4; Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry/Fiber.lean:103 and AffineScheme.lean:72

proof.text: For an inducing map g, restriction to the inverse image of any open neighbourhood is inducing, hence its Krull dimension is at most that of the neighbourhood. Taking infima gives dimAt(x) ≤ dimAt(g(x)). Applying this to a homeomorphism and its inverse gives equality. This is proved by the private helpers dimensionAt_inducing_le and dimensionAt_homeomorph, using IsInducing.restrictPreimage and IsInducing.topologicalKrullDim_le.

The homeomorphism f.fiberHomeo(f(y)) takes f.asFiber(y) to (y,rfl) in the set-theoretic fibre. Naturality of X.isoSpec identifies contraction of its image point with T.isoSpec(f(x)). Restrict the canonical affine homeomorphism to the fibres using Homeomorph.subtype; injectivity of T.isoSpec proves the membership equivalence. It carries (y,rfl) to (q,rfl).

PrimeSpectrum.preimageHomeomorphFiber identifies this set-theoretic ring-map fibre with Spec(κ(p) tensor_A B), taking (q,rfl) to its canonical fibre prime. Apply the local-dimension equality of step 1 to the three homeomorphisms and concatenate the equalities.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_coordinate_fibre_dimension_eq
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T) (y : X) :
    let : Algebra Γ(T, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤) := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, ⊤) := X.isoSpec.hom y
    topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) =
      topologicalKrullDimAt
        ((PrimeSpectrum.preimageHomeomorphFiber Γ(T, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤)
          (q.comap (algebraMap Γ(T, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤)))) ⟨q, rfl⟩)
